_comment: Movies tracked by scripts/discover_zineflix_shows.py. To onboard a new movie, add an entry here — the scraper will pick it up on the next run. Fields: slug (site slug matching booking.html key), zineflixMovieId (from zineflix.com URL, e.g. /movie/places/show-cities/Paradise/77 -> 77), title/genre/language/page (used when regenerating booking.html for new shows).
